decision_basis: fixed from eye-movement conventions and the 250 Hz sampling rate, before any V3 feature distribution or model score
input_windows: assignment3/cache/windows_v2.parquet; V2 quality policy and windows unchanged
samples: A1 cache code screens after the >1,000 deg/s velocity filter, exactly as in quality.py
velocity: left-eye screen coordinates, centred over three samples, A1 pixels-per-degree geometry
valid_velocity: all three samples measured ('ok') and both intervals <= 20 ms; otherwise the middle sample is unclassified and ends any event
fixation_duration: last minus first sample time plus one nominal 4 ms period
saccade_vector: from the sample before the first to the sample after the last saccade sample
window_edges: events never cross window edges; an event cut by an edge counts within its window
empty_event_fill: means and fractions are 0 when a window has no qualifying event; rates keep that information

features.fixation_time_fraction: summed fixation duration divided by window duration
features.saccade_amplitude_mean_deg: mean saccade vector length in degrees
features.leftward_saccade_fraction: share of horizontal saccades with dx < 0; includes regressions and line-return sweeps
features.upward_saccade_fraction: share of saccades with |dy| > |dx| and dy < 0 (screen y grows downward)

translation_invariance: every event feature uses only coordinate differences; checked by shifting all real windows

justification.why_events: V2 summaries describe spread and speed but not reading structure; fixations and saccades are the standard units of reading research and may carry how-information without absolute position
justification.threshold_30: common I-VT default (Olsen, 2012, Tobii I-VT filter) for screen-based trackers
justification.min_fixation_60: the same source discards shorter fixations as noise; 60 ms is 15 samples at 250 Hz
justification.interval_20: same bound as V2 velocity features; longer intervals are holes, not movement
justification.interpolated_samples: A1 linear interpolation fills blinks with straight lines, so it would invent smooth fixations or saccades
justification.no_tuning: thresholds are conventional operating values, not tuned on this data
